description: Pixel-perfect general multi-step SIGN UP (Figma Sign Up 1 = node 89:4922, Sign Up 2 = node 221:1217): rework RegisterForm into a 2-step form over the SAME react-hook-form form + createRegisterSchema, and rebuild register/page.tsx inside the shell. Step 1 = role selection (SelectableCardGroup) + identity fields; step 2 = remaining fields + social sign-in buttons. Reuse useRegister and keep the submit payload/contract and the public RegisterForm export unchanged. Depends on FEAT-001; independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Read context.json, this file, and the Sign Up section of figma-auth.md. Run the figma power get_design_context on node 89:4922 (Sign Up 1) and node 221:1217 (Sign Up 2), fileKey y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR, to capture the exact fields, order, labels, placeholders, and social-button layout. Add any new copy keys discovered to messages/ar.json + en.json (in sync) under the auth namespace (e.g. registerHeading, registerSubheading, step labels, nextButton, social button labels, 'لديك حساب؟'/'سجل الدخول' footer).

Edit src/features/auth/components/register-form.tsx: keep 'use client', useForm<RegisterValues> with zodResolver(createRegisterSchema(tv)), useRegister(), the existing defaultValues and field names (firstName,lastName,email,password,confirmPassword,role), and the onSubmit that strips confirmPassword before registerMutation.mutate(payload). Add local React state 'const [step, setStep] = React.useState<1|2>(1)'. Render step 1: a role selector using SelectableCardGroup (from @/components/molecules) wired to the 'role' field via RHF Controller (options from roleList with tr(role) headings and role icons StudentIcon/ParentIcon/TeacherIcon), plus the identity fields per Figma (firstName/lastName/email) using the same Label(+required '*')/Input(md, with icons)/error pattern as LoginForm. A 'next' Button (type=button, primary, full width) calls 'await trigger([...step1 fields]) && setStep(2)'. Render step 2: the remaining fields per Figma (password + confirmPassword with usePasswordToggle + PasswordIcon) and the social sign-in buttons (outline/ghost Buttons each with GoogleIcon/FacebookIcon/AppleIcon from @/components/icons), a 'back' Button (type=button) to setStep(1), and the final submit Button (type=submit) with the pending spinner and t('registerCta'). Keep logical properties only. Do NOT change the schema or useRegister.

Edit src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/page.tsx: remove the Card usage; render inside the shell card <LogoMark size={144} /> + heading block (title/subtitle from the new auth keys) + <RegisterForm /> + a centered footer with t('hasAccount') + a secondary underlined Link to routes.login with t('loginCta'). Keep generateMetadata + setRequestLocale.
Keep the public export: src/features/auth/index.ts still exports RegisterForm (unchanged). If helper subcomponents are extracted, keep them internal to the components folder.

Pixel compare: get_screenshot on 89:4922 and 221:1217 and compare against the built step 1 / step 2; iterate until no visible 1px drift (layout, spacing, colors, radii, typography) in RTL + light/dark.
acceptance_criteria: RegisterForm renders as a 2-step flow over one RHF form; role is chosen via SelectableCardGroup; step 1 validates before advancing to step 2.
The submit still calls useRegister with the existing RegisterPayload shape (confirmPassword stripped); schema and field names unchanged; schemas.test.ts passes.
register/page.tsx renders inside the shell (no Card) with logo + heading + RegisterForm + login footer link.
Social sign-in buttons use the brand GoogleIcon/FacebookIcon/AppleIcon.
Sign Up step 1 matches node 89:4922 and step 2 matches node 221:1217 with no visible 1px drift.
verification: From repo root: npm run typegen ; npm run typecheck ; npm run lint ; npm run test ; npm run build — all pass with 0 errors.
get_screenshot on 89:4922 and 221:1217 compared to the built steps shows a pixel match.
